title: Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc. Announces Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Earnings Conference Call

# Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc. Announces Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Earnings Conference Call


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_831fe3d060fab52922e616b3cf6e88a2/flooranddecor/news/2026-10-08_Floor_Decor_Holdings_Inc_Announces_Third_Quarter_305.pdf) October 08, 2026 4:05pm EDT


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: FND), the leading high-growth retailer specializing in hard-surface flooring for homeowners and professionals, today announced that its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 will be released after market close on Thursday, October 29, 2026. The company will host a conference call at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time to discuss the financial results. A live audio webcast of the conference call, together with related materials, will be available online at[ir.flooranddecor.com](http://ir.flooranddecor.com/) .


A recorded replay of the conference call will be available approximately three hours after the conclusion of the call and can be accessed both online at[ir.flooranddecor.com](http://ir.flooranddecor.com/) and by dialing 844-512-2921 (international callers please dial 412-317-6671). The pin number to access the telephone replay is 13762956. The replay will be available until November 5, 2026.


**About Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc.**


Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of June 25, 2026, the Company operated 281 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
